# function: imagebuilder_image

Builds the ARN for `imagebuilder` `image`:

```
arn:${Partition}:imagebuilder:${Region}:${Account}:image/${ImageName}/${ImageVersion}/${ImageBuildVersion}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:imagebuilder:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:image/image-name/image-version/image-build-version
output "imagebuilder_image" {
  value = provider::arn::imagebuilder_image("image-name", "image-version", "image-build-version")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
imagebuilder_image(image_name string, image_version string, image_build_version string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `image_name` (String) Value for `${ImageName}` in the ARN template.
1. `image_version` (String) Value for `${ImageVersion}` in the ARN template.
1. `image_build_version` (String) Value for `${ImageBuildVersion}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
